Examine only the attached image pixels. Do not read files, use tools, consult prior sessions, or infer unreadable text. Transcribe this board-game card exactly. Return: ORIENTATION; TITLE; TYPE_LINE; BODY_TEXT verbatim with line breaks, capitalization, punctuation, and literal bracketed descriptions for icons; every standalone icon and location; whether it is a self-contained item or instructs gaining another physical card; UNCERTAIN_OR_ILLEGIBLE. Describe icon morphology before assigning a game meaning. Do not modify files.

[Image attached at: /home/smithers/nemesis-retaliation/assets/tts-mod/extract/v2-dl/tree/cards/game/reditem-148_cards/card-00.png]
[screenshot]

ORIENTATION: Portrait; upright.

TITLE: AMMO MAGAZINE

TYPE_LINE:
ONE USE ONLY,
SPECIAL WEAPON

BODY_TEXT:
You can use this Item for free
immediately after gaining it.

Gain up to 2 [red icon: wide rectangular block with five narrow vertical slots on its left side, joined to a rounded rectangular outline protruding on the right]

ICONS:
- Lower body text, immediately after “2”: red icon morphologically described as a wide rectangular block with five narrow vertical slots on its left side, joined to a rounded rectangular outline protruding on the right. Apparent game meaning: ammunition/ammo units.

PHYSICAL_ITEM_STATUS: Self-contained Item; it does not instruct the player to gain another physical card.

UNCERTAIN_OR_ILLEGIBLE: No text is illegible. The icon’s game meaning is inferred from its morphology and the title; the pixels contain no written icon label.
